formulations.Polymer system Notes: PEC (Mn = 3.7×10^4 g/mol, donated by a Japanese company) is a commercial aliphatic polycarbonate made by alternating copolymerization of CO2 and ethylene oxide. 1H/13C NMR showed ~95% carbonate linkages and ~5% residual ether (ethylene-oxide) linkages in the main chain. PEC was purified (dissolved in CHCl3, precipitated in excess MeOH, vacuum dried 60°C/24h) then dissolved with LiX salt in acetonitrile, cast into film, dried in N2 then vacuum at 60°C/24h. Films with 5-60 mol% salt were self-standing; 80 mol% (LiTFSI) was a rubbery solid.
formulations.Notes: Salt concentration 20 mol%. FT-IR C=O band: free 45% at 1755 cm-1, interacting (Li+ coordinated) 55% at 1721 cm-1. No t+ or conductivity reported at this concentration for LiTFSI.
formulations.Reference: Tominaga, Y.; Yamazaki, K.; Nanthana, V. J. Electrochem. Soc. 2015, 162, A3133-A3136.
